nodes.description:
Updates a product.

Each time the product is updated, `revision` increments by 1.
The current `revision` must be passed when updating the product.
This ensures you're working with the latest product and prevents unintended overwrites.

>**Notes:**
> + To update array fields like `options`, `modifiers`, `variantsInfo.variants`, and any others, you must pass the entire existing array. Passing only the changed item overwrites the entire array, not just merge the single change.
> + To update `variantsInfo.variants` you must also pass `options` and vice versa. This is because variants and options are mutually dependent and must be aligned.
> + To update existing `variantsInfo.variants`, make sure to provide `variantsInfo.variants.id`. If no ID is passed, a variant is created with a new ID.
> + Updating media per variant isn't supported. Instead, assign media items to product option choices using the `linkedMedia` field. You must use preexisting product media.
> + Partial-update semantics: Update Product supports partial updates with the following rules:
>   - At the request level, only `product`, `product.id`, and `product.revision` are required.
>   - Other fields shown as required in the schema apply only when their parent field is provided.
>   - Top-level fields you omit (for example, `name`, `ribbon`, `brand`, `taxGroupId`) are left unchanged.
>   - The full-array overwrite rule applies only to repeated fields (`options`, `modifiers`, `variantsInfo.variants`); top-level scalar and object fields are partially updatable on their own.

type AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaKeyword {
  """
  Whether this is the page's primary focus keyword. At most one per page.
  """
  isMain: Boolean

  """
  Which surface added the term, e.g. a panel or a suggestion flow. Used for
  attribution in BI. Opaque to the renderer.
  """
  origin: String

  """
  The term itself, e.g. "trail running shoes".
  
  No maxLength, for the same reason as the legacy tag fields: keywords are
  already stored, and a bound added now could reject a record written
  before the bound existed. The flynt `missing-string-validations` warning
  on this field is accepted deliberately.
  """
  term: String
}

input AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaKeywordInput {
  """
  Whether this is the page's primary focus keyword. At most one per page.

  origin: String

type AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaSettings {
  """
  Keyword terms the user is targeting for this page. Used by the SEO
  assistant and checklist; never rendered into <head>.
  
  20 is a sanity bound, not the product limit. v1 declared 5 — the number
  the panel happens to allow today — which is exactly the mistake we are
  fixing for structured data. A product decision to allow 8 should not need
  a proto release, so the panel owns that number and the proto only stops
  something absurd.
  """
  keywords: [AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaKeyword]

  """
  Whether to suppress the automatic redirect from this page's previous URL to
  its current one after a slug change.
  
  Default false, meaning the redirect IS created. The field is named for the
  exception rather than the rule, which reads backwards; kept as-is because
  renaming a stored boolean is not worth the migration.
  """
  preventAutoRedirect: Boolean
}

input AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaSettingsInput {
  """
  Keyword terms the user is targeting for this page. Used by the SEO
  assistant and checklist; never rendered into <head>.
  
  20 is a sanity bound, not the product limit. v1 declared 5 — the number
  the panel happens to allow today — which is exactly the mistake we are
  fixing for structured data. A product decision to allow 8 should not need
  a proto release, so the panel owns that number and the proto only stops
  something absurd.
  """
  keywords: [AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaKeywordInput]

  """
  Whether to suppress the automatic redirect from this page's previous URL to
  its current one after a slug change.
  
  Default false, meaning the redirect IS created. The field is named for the
  exception rather than the rule, which reads backwards; kept as-is because
  renaming a stored boolean is not worth the migration.
  """
  preventAutoRedirect: Boolean
}

type AdvancedSeoSeoSchemaTag {
  """
  Legacy. Was the tag's inner content, doubling as the JSON-LD payload
  for script tags. Typed replacement: `SeoSchemaV2.TitleTag.text` and
  `StructuredDataTag.json_ld`.
  No length limit, for the same reason as `type` above.
  """
  children: String

  """
  Whether the tag is a [custom tag](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-additional-meta-tags-to-your-sites-pages) —
  i.e. an entry from the site's Advanced/Custom Tags list.
  
  Setting this to `true` on a write restricts which `type` values are
  accepted — the same restriction the Advanced/Custom Tags UI enforces.
  `title` and `script` tags (including JSON-LD structured data) must be sent
  with `custom` omitted or `false`; sending them with `custom: true` is
  rejected with `TAG_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED`.
  
  Note this is a separate restriction from Site SEO Tags' own type
  restriction on `SiteSeoTags.tags`: even with `custom` unset, Site SEO Tags
  rejects `script` (e.g. for site-wide structured data) unconditionally.
  There is currently no way to set site-wide, every-page structured data
  through any of these APIs — write a per-page `script` tag through the Item
  SEO Tags API instead.
  
  This flag is scoped to that feature only. It is NOT an indicator of whether a standard tag
  (`title`, `description`, Open Graph, etc.) reflects a manually configured value versus a computed
  default/pattern — standard tags always resolve with `custom: false`, even when their content comes
  from a page's manually saved SEO title/description override. Don't use this field to verify whether
  a live page reflects a manual per-page SEO edit.
  
  Limitation: when `ResolveStaticPageSeoTags` is called without `seoData`, the per-page SEO data is read
  only from the Vibe/Wix-managed-headless override store. That store holds nothing for classic Wix Editor
  or Wix Studio pages, so even genuine Advanced/Custom Tags saved on those pages are missing from the
  response entirely — there, `false` means this API could not tell, not that no custom tag exists.
  Pass `seoData` explicitly to resolve against a known set of tags.
  
  `SeoSchemaV2.Tag` expresses this as `written_by = USER_CUSTOM`.
  """
  custom: Boolean

  """
  Whether the tag is excluded from the rendered <head>.
  
  A disabled tag is still stored, so the user can re-enable it and so a
  pattern-provided tag stays suppressed on this page. Default false.
  """
  disabled: Boolean

  """
  Legacy. Was an untyped bag of 16 mixed-purpose keys. In `SeoSchemaV2`
  its contents are split by purpose: per-page structured-data state moves to
  StructuredDataTag, authorship to `written_by`, and render-time preset

  """
  Creates a service.
  
  
  ### Required fields
  
  When creating a service you must specify the following fields:
  - [`type`](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/services/services-v2/about-service-types):
  Whether it's an appointment-based service, class, or course.
  - `name`: Service name that's displayed to customers.
  - `onlineBooking`:
  Settings determining whether customers can book online, whether the business
  must manually confirm bookings, and whether customers can request to book an
  appointment time slot that already has a booking request awaiting business
  confirmation.
  - [`payment`](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/services/services-v2/about-service-payments):
  How customers can pay when signing up for the service.
  - `defaultCapacity`: The maximum number of customers that can book the service. Required for all service types.
  - For appointment-based services, it must be `1`.
  - For classes, set to the maximum number of participants per session.
  - For courses, set to the maximum number of participants for the course.
  
  ### Category
  
  Set `category.id` to assign the service to a [category](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/services/categories/introduction).
  Without an assigned category, the service isn't visible on the live site.
  
  ### Online booking
  
  Set `onlineBooking.enabled` to `true` so customers can book the service online.
  When enabled, the service is included in the [single-service booking flow](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/flow-single-service-booking).
  
  ### Approval
  
  Set `onlineBooking.requireManualApproval` to control whether bookings need business approval before confirmation.
  Services with manual approval enabled can't accept pricing plan payments.
  
  ### Payment
  
  Set `payment.rateType` to `FIXED`, `VARIED`, `CUSTOM`, or `NO_FEE` and specify the corresponding rate details:
  - `FIXED`: Set `payment.fixed.price`.
  - `VARIED`: Set `payment.varied.defaultPrice`.
  - `CUSTOM`: Set `payment.custom.description`.
  - `NO_FEE`: No additional rate details required.
  
  Configure `payment.options` to control how customers can pay.
  At least one of `inPerson` or `online` must be `true`, even for services with `rateType` of `NO_FEE`.
  
  - `online`: Customers can pay online. Requires `rateType` of `FIXED` or `VARIED`.
  - `inPerson`: Customers can pay in person.
  - `deposit`: A deposit is required to book. Requires `rateType` of `FIXED` or `VARIED` and a `deposit` amount in the rate details.
  - `pricingPlan`: Customers can pay using a [pricing plan](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/pricing-plans/plans/introduction).
  Can't be used in combination with manual approval.
  
  Learn more about [service payments](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/services/services-v2/about-service-payments).

  supported session durations.
  
  __Classes and courses__
  
  Don't specify `schedule.availabilityConstraints.sessionDurations`.
  
  __Appointment-based services without varied pricing based on session length__
  
  Specify the single supported session duration in the
  `schedule.availabilityConstraints.sessionDurations` array.
  
  __Appointment-based services with varied pricing based on session length__
  
  - Specify all supported session durations in `schedule.availabilityConstraints.sessionDurations`.
  - Note that Wix Bookings doesn't display these values to customers and
  ignores them in pricing and availability calculations. Instead session
  durations are retrieved from the relevant [service variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/services/service-options-and-variants/introduction).
  - It is mandatory to specify `schedule.availabilityConstraints.sessionDurations`,
  even though these values are ignored.
  
  ### Staff members
  
  For appointment-based services, at least one entry in `staffMemberIds` is required.
  Set it to the [resource](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/bookings/resources/resources-v2/introduction) IDs of the staff members who can provide the service.
  Note that despite the field name, `staffMemberIds` contains resource IDs from `staffMember.resourceId`,
  not staff member IDs. Query staff members with the `RESOURCE_DETAILS` field set to retrieve `resourceId`.
  
  ### Buffer time
  
  For appointment-based services, you can set `schedule.availabilityConstraints.timeBetweenSessions` to add buffer time between booked sessions.

type EcomMembershipsSpiV1PurchasablePlan {
  """
  Benefits the plan grants once purchased.
  
  A plan can grant several, for example a bundle granting separate yoga and pilates credits. Each
  benefit becomes its own membership after purchase.
  """
  benefits: [EcomMembershipsSpiV1Benefit]

  """
  Catalog and item reference identifying both the plan and the pricing variant.
  
  A purchasable plan has no ID of its own. The reference carries the plan in `catalogItemId` and
  the chosen pricing variant in `options`, so the same plan appears once per variant with a
  different reference each time. The plan ID alone repeats across entries; the full reference
  doesn't.
  
  When the plan needs nothing further from the buyer, the reference can be added to the cart as it
  stands. When it does, for example a plan carrying a form, a custom start date, or a buyer-chosen
  price, the reference has to be completed with that input first. See `infoCollectionUrl`.
  """
  catalogReference: EcommerceCatalogSpiV1CatalogReference

  """
  URL of the page that collects the extra input this plan needs before it can be purchased.
  
  Return it only for a plan that needs more from the buyer, such as one carrying a form, a custom
  start date, or a buyer-chosen price. Omitting it means the plan needs nothing further, and the
  caller builds the cart itself.
  
  The buyer reaches this page before any cart exists, rather than from the checkout page, and
  there's no return trip. The page receives the caller's already-created items, then builds the
  cart and checkout from the plan plus those items. There's no return URL, no cart ID, no
  preserved selection, and no completion signal: the purchase reaches Wix through the ordinary
  checkout and order flow, and the membership through Membership Ready To Be Charged.
  
  The page covers a single plan. Items that plan covers can be mixed with directly-paid ones, but
  a selection spanning two plans isn't supported here.
  """
  infoCollectionUrl: String

  """Plan name."""
  name: EcomMembershipsSpiV1MembershipName

  """
  Human-readable summary of what the plan offers, for display. For example, `8 yoga classes and 4
  pilates classes, billed monthly`.
  
  Describe the offering here and the price in `priceDescription`.
  """
  offeringDescription: String

  """
  Plan price, in the plan's own configured currency.
  
  No currency accompanies the amount and none is converted, so prices from different plans aren't
  comparable and the currency reaches the buyer only through `priceDescription`. Name the currency
  there.
  """
  price: String

  """
  Human-readable summary of the plan price, for display. For example, `First month free, then
  $20/month`.

  pricing a buyer needs prose to understand.
  """
  priceDescription: String
}

Capture them with [Capture Authorized Payments](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-billing/capture-authorized-payments) or release them with [Void Authorized Payments](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-billing/void-authorized-payments). enum EcomOrdersV1PaymentStatusEnumPaymentStatus {
  UNSPECIFIED

  """
  `NOT_PAID` can apply to an order made online, but not yet paid. In such cases `order.status` will be `INITIALIZED`.
  This status also applies when an offline order needs to be manually marked as paid. In such cases `order.status` will be `APPROVED`.
  """
  NOT_PAID

  """All required payments associated with this order are paid."""
  PAID

  """
  Order partially refunded, but the refunded amount is less than the order's total price. See `order.balanceSummary` for more details.
  """
  PARTIALLY_REFUNDED

  """
  Order fully refunded. Refund amount equals total price. See `order.balanceSummary` for more details.
  """
  FULLY_REFUNDED

  """
  All payments pending.
  
  This can happen with two-step payments, when a payment requires manual review, or when a payment is in progress and will be concluded shortly.
  Learn more about [pending orders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pending-orders).
  """
  PENDING

  """
  At least one payment received and approved, but it covers less than the order's total price. See `order.balanceSummary` for more details.
  """
  PARTIALLY_PAID

  """
  Payment received, but not yet confirmed by the payment provider.
  
  In most cases, when a payment provider is holding payment it's because setup hasn't been successfully completed by the merchant/site owner.
  To solve this, the merchant/site owner should log in to the payment provider's dashboard and make sure their account is set up correctly, or contact their support for further assistance.
  """
  PENDING_MERCHANT

  """One or more payments canceled."""
  CANCELED

  """One or more payments declined."""
  DECLINED
}
